{"metadata":{"description":"A curated, evidence-led directory of DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins: verified loadable extensions, skills, and permission-aware installation guidance.","id":"gh:1333307673","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"awesome-dsh-plugins","slug":"cccakeee/awesome-dsh-plugins","topics":["awesome","awesome-list","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A curated, evidence-led directory of DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins: verified loadable extensions, s"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"kills, and permission-aware installation guidance."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# awesome-dsh-plugins"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | **简体中文** | 🌐 网站"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 一个面向 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）][1] 的精选插件目录。项目优先收录**可由 DSH Profile 装载**、具备可复现安装说明且源码公开的社区扩展；技能、预设与相关应用"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"会明确区分，不把“使用 DeepSeek API”或仅贴有 `dsh-plugin` 标签的项目误当作原生插件。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 目前处于 **Developer Preview**。官方采用 Cordis 的“Everything is a plugin”架构：Profile 组合 Bundl"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"e，外部插件通常以 `package.json` 的 `dsh` 字段及 patch 文件声明挂载方式。[1] [2] 因此，本目录中的安装方法和兼容性应在你自己的 DSH 版本上先行验证。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**快照日期：2026-11-09。** 本版主目录收录 **2665 个**经源码或安装清单核验的插件与 Skill，按 22 个能力分类组织（与配套网站 deepseekharnessplugin"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"s.com 同构）；完整清单已拆分到 `docs/categories/` 的 22 个分类页面。同时提供 **全量聚合目录 `CATALOG.md`（3459 个仓库）**，合并 GitHub 搜索"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"与多个社区目录去重后得到。**聚合 ≠ 可装载、可兼容、可安全运行**；只有本目录核验子集进入主目录，证据见 data/verified-plugins.csv 与 data/audit-result"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"后得到。**聚合 ≠ 可装载、可兼容、可安全运行**；只有本目录核验子集进入主目录，证据见 data/verified-plugins.csv 与 data/audit-results.csv。[3]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| 导航 | 内容 |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| 全量聚合目录 | **3459 个** DSH 相关仓库的完整聚合（含未审核候选）；审计日志 |
| 已核验插件目录 | 按 22 个能力分类的已核验可装载扩展（与网站同构） |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 全量聚合目录"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`CATALOG.md` 是自动生成的**全量聚合目录**：它把 GitHub `dsh-plugin` / `deepseek-harness` 话题、名称搜索、`dsh-plugin` 主题页候选"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"快照以及多个社区目录（bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin、Alex-Yanggg/awesome-DSH-plugin、awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"-plugin、AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins）中发现的**全部**仓库合并去重。机器可读版本是 `data/repositories.csv`。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- 聚合池是**发现清单**，不是推荐或兼容性列表；只有 `✅` 已核验子集进入下方主目录。
- 用 scripts/aggregate.py 重新拉取并重建 `CATALOG.md` 与 `data"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"/repositories.csv`（需要 `gh` 登录）。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 安全与鉴权"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| 插件 | 能力 | 安装或挂载方式 | 许可 / 风险 |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| LYL-Z/dsh-armorbreak | Add an evidence-first security-research mode with scoped analysis tools, po"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"licy gates, bundled skills, and reproducible evidence reports. | `plugin_manager action=install_bund"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"le target="<BUNDLE_PATH>"; for a CLI test profile, add the source with & $dsh plugin --profile abmte"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"st add link:"<REPO_PATH>" after creating abmtest from the web profile.` | MIT；The README calls v2.3."},{"id":"p14s5","text":"1 an active stable release candidate rather than a verified Stable release and states that AI-assist"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ed review is not human security certification; use only within an explicitly authorized scope and ve"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"rify optional tool availability. |
| openguardrails/openguardrails-spec | Guards DSH model requests "},{"id":"p14s8","text":"and responses and can gate tool approvals through an OpenGuardrails runtime. | `dsh plugin --profile"},{"id":"p14s9","text":" web add @openguardrails/dsh` | Apache-2.0；The nested package repository field points to openguardra"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"ils/openguardrails while the reviewed source is openguardrails-spec; verify release provenance and r"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"emember the documented default fail-open behavior. |

| SteelUnion/dsh-c"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"onfirm-gate | Counts persistent operations per turn, injects stop reminders, and asks for user confi"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"rm at configurable hard limits. | `npx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add github:Steel"},{"id":"p14s17","text":"Union/dsh-confirm-gate; restart DSH.` | MIT；This is an accounting/confirmation layer rather than a s"},{"id":"p14s18","text":"andbox or prompt-injection boundary; any user message containing confirmWord releases the whole turn"},{"id":"p14s19","text":", and compatibility follows the declared DSH range. |

| `session-*`、`subagent-*`、`schedule`、`workflow-*` | 会话、子 Agent、日程与工作流 | 官方源码 packages |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 安装与安全"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"先安装 DSH 并启动一个 Profile。官方快速开始方式是："},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"随后使用项目说明中给出的 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add …` 命令。安装前应锁定版本或 commit、阅读 `package.json`、`cordis.pa"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"tch.yml` 与依赖安装脚本；不要在不了解代码的情况下执行 `curl \| bash`、`pnpm` 生命周期脚本或授予系统级凭据。"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| 风险级别 | 涉及项目示例 | 安装前的最低措施 |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| 高 | `dsh-better-browser`、`dsh-ssh`、`jumpserver-dsh`、飞书桥接 | 使用隔离 Profile、最小权限凭据、主机/域名白名单与人工审批；不得将生产"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"密钥写入仓库 |
